episodes.title: Cult leader Kim Miller, "Speakeasy," 1987 cable television interview with Peter Jones
episodes.description: Anti-cult activist Kim Miller turned-cult-leader Kim Miller in a rare TV interview before he erroneously predicted the destruction of Denver by an earthquake in the 1990s and then disappeared from Denver along with his followers, without trace or explanation or irony and winding up in Israel as part of an apocalyptic doomsday cult and claiming he had never predicted the destruction of Denver in the first place. But here he is, warning of the danger of cults without nary a twinkle in his eye.
